run_GoalFollower_agent: run a GoalFollower agent that navigates toward a goal using angle-based turning and forward movement
run_RandomAgent: run a RandomAgent that randomly chooses move_forward, turn_left, or turn_right actions until goal is reached
run_ForwardOnlyAgent: run a ForwardOnlyAgent that only moves forward until the goal distance threshold is met
run_RandomForwardAgent: run a RandomForwardAgent that moves forward 80% of the time and turns left or right 20% of the time
run_benchmark_evaluation: run a benchmark evaluation for any agent subclass using a task config YAML and success distance threshold
